name: What are the benefits of repairing a rotted sliding door frame versus replacing the entire door unit?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing a rotted sliding door frame versus replacing the entire door unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a rotted sliding door frame can be a more cost-effective option than replacing the entire door unit, especially if the door itself is still in good condition and only the frame is compromised. It also minimizes disruption to your home, as the existing door and surrounding structure remain largely intact. Repairs can be quicker to complete, and you avoid the potential aesthetic inconsistencies of a new door unit. However, if the rot is extensive or recurrent, a full replacement might offer better long-term durability and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing is often more cost-effective and less disruptive than full replacement if the door itself is still functional and only the frame has isolated rot.
